title.en: Dialysis Unit Default Engineering Scoring Model

authority.note: Weights are an owner decision, not a developer default. Editing this file changes how layouts are ranked and is a reviewable change; see docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md B-5a.

minimumCoverageNote: Owner decision D1, value decided by the GM: below this fraction of the model's weight no total is offered — coverage and the criterion table are shown instead. MEASURED against the shipped vantive_ak98.json over all 32 reference-point subsets, not against a test fixture (an earlier note mixed the two and stated a figure that was wrong). Three criteria are unmeasurable on every project today: compliance_margin 0.40 (SC-904, no threshold until the AK98 installation standards arrive), installation_feasibility 0.20 (SC-905, no observed delivery allowance) and maintenance_access 0.15 (AK98's service clearances are all null). That is 0.75. Reachable coverages are exactly {0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25}; 0.25 is the CEILING, reached only when every reference point that can move it is placed, and 0.05 is what an unreferenced drawing scores. Only three kinds move it at all — ro_supply 0.10, electrical_panel 0.05, staff_base 0.05 — because drain_routing carries weight 0 and installation_feasibility is SC-905 whether access_entry is placed or not. 0.25 is chosen because it is the only non-arbitrary value: it means the engineer supplied everything obtainable today. 0.20 would be an admission threshold with no principle behind it. The cost is that a drawing missing ro_supply, electrical_panel or staff_base gets no proposals — deliberate, because that engineer has not yet made the decision a ranking would rest on; the panel still shows coverage, the criterion table and an SC-901 naming the missing kind. Raising this above 0.25 suspends ranking entirely until the AK98 manual and observed drawings arrive. Reversing this decision is this one number and no code change.

compliance_margin.note: Two roles, and they are not the same thing. A rule *violation* excludes a candidate at Gate 2, before scoring. This 40% weights the *quality* of the margin among candidates that already comply — it is never permission to trade a violation against an optimisation score.

drain_routing.note: Named in the owner's criterion list but absent from the approved B-5a weight table. Measured and shown in every breakdown at weight 0 so it is visible and can be weighted by editing this file. Not silently deleted, and not silently weighted.

station_count.note: Deliberately NOT a weighted criterion. Station count is a target the engineer sets and the solver satisfies; scoring then ranks arrangements that meet it. A weight of 0 in a maximise-total model would rank the emptiest room first, because every other criterion improves as machines are removed. Measured and displayed like a criterion; never traded against one.
